summary: Adds a first-class app-owned project settings surface on the Options admin panel. Downstream apps can register superuser-only settings tiles from their autodiscovered dlux_options.py with register_app_settings(...), using simple built-in Dlux controls (toggles, selectors, text/number/json fields) or a custom Django form. Each modal saves only the registered SystemSettings.extra_config['app'][namespace] value through the same namespace-scoped, size-capped, audit-logged app-system-config writer, so the core System Settings form remains Dlux-only and secure. Inline-safe: no migration, JSON/view/static/template/docs updates only.
highlights: register_app_settings(...): downstream apps can expose project-specific settings as superuser-only Options admin tiles from their existing dlux_options.py integration module.
Built-in controls cover boolean toggles, choice/multiple-choice selectors, text, number, integer, and JSON fields; choice fields can use Dlux selector variants such as card and toggle.
Custom forms are supported with an optional to_app_config(current_value) hook for projects that need their own validation or layout.
Saves stay isolated to SystemSettings.extra_config['app'][namespace] and reuse the namespace-scoped, size-capped, audit-logged app-system-config writer; core System Settings stays Dlux-only.
The generated form preserves unknown keys already present in the app namespace so adding/removing surfaced fields does not wipe other project-owned config.
